pending_device_ownership.serialization_requirement: Selected single-adapter init and shutdown under the original API lock.
pending_device_ownership.record: Exact nv_state owner, GPU instance and GPUMGR device instance between successful create and attach transfer.
pending_device_ownership.failed_destroy: Retain record and GPU lock; reject overwrite and checked shutdown; observer reports resources.

rmapi_allocation.gpu_lock_failure_boolean: NV_FALSE, never a nonzero NV_STATUS success conversion.
rmapi_allocation.partial_handle_cleanup_owner: Sole RmInitAdapter caller performs one checked shutdown; allocator performs no hidden Free.

partial_gsp_attempt.record_point: Immediately before actual kgspInitRm; reject any existing attempt record.
partial_gsp_attempt.incomplete_gpu_state: Checked shutdown returns NOT_READY before freeing any RMAPI/core/GPU/DMA/register resources.
partial_gsp_attempt.record_clear_requirement: Complete checked shutdown success together with the separate required GSP status source profile.

limitations: Partial destructive cleanup is quarantined, not retryable.
Original void engine destructors and DMA quiescence still require independent review.
This patch alone does not establish safe PM completion or target-kernel admission.
